bias.en: Bearish · Oct 28 jump undone, MACD crossed back down
bias.zh: 偏空 · 10月28日涨幅尽失，MACD 再度下穿

read.en: Micron fell 5.3% on Oct 30 to $884.74 (range $861.59–906.54), after a 5.0% drop on Oct 29. It is below the rising 5-day ($926.94) and the falling 10-day ($908.34), 30-day ($991.45) and 100-day ($970.90), and above the rising 200-day ($746.83). MACD crossed back below its signal on Oct 30, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 28 ($854.82), and RSI is 42.

Two down days erased the Oct 28 jump and broke all three written supports ($907–972), now resistance. Resistance is $902.6–908.3 (Sep 14 low, 10-day), then $927–936 (5-day, Oct 27 high) and $959–971 (Oct 28 low, 100-day). Support is $861.6 (Oct 30 low), then $849–855 (Oct 22 and Jun 9 lows, SAR) and $804 (Jul 17 low). A close above $908 would target $927–936; below $849, $804.
read.zh: 两日下跌抹去 10月28日涨幅，并跌破此前三道支撑（$907–972），这些位置转为阻力。阻力为 $902.6–908.3（9月14日低点、10 日均线），其次 $927–936（5 日均线、10月27日高点）和 $959–971（10月28日低点、100 日均线）。支撑为 $861.6（10月30日低点），其次 $849–855（10月22日和6月9日低点、SAR）和 $804（7月17日低点）。若收盘站上 $908，下一目标看 $927–936；若跌破 $849，则看 $804。

s.en: Oct 22 low $849.25; Jun 9 low $854.35; Parabolic SAR $854.82
